title: SAFETY FOR WHOM? BENCHMARKING UNDERSTANDING BEYOND REFUSAL IN EGOCENTRIC MULTIMODAL ASSISTANTS

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the model's unsafe response rates to identical harmful queries synthesized with child versus adult voices to test if the model adapts its safety behavior based on the user's apparent age.
